hook: Clear the *speaking round* of company assessments

slides.title: Know the format
slides.body: Many companies use automated English tests: read aloud, repeat sentences, short answers, listening.

slides.title: Read aloud = pace + clarity
slides.body: Don't rush. Read at a steady speed, stress key words, pause at commas and full stops.

slides.title: Repeat-the-sentence trick
slides.body: Listen for meaning, not single words. It's easier to repeat an idea than a string of words.

slides.title: Practise with a timer
slides.body: These tests are timed. Silence costs marks, so start speaking within 2 seconds.
